rows.gesture: type into the quick-entry field
choose an insertion boundary for the draft
activate Clear or press Escape in the draft field
activate Insert on a ready preview
activate Insert this chord on one recoverable token
activate a measure insertion target
activate a section insertion target
press Delete or choose Delete from the More menu
press Alt+D or choose Duplicate
press Alt+ArrowLeft or choose Move previous
press Alt+ArrowRight or choose Move next
drop a dragged handle on a boundary, or choose Move before/after
choose Move following events from the overfill notice
press Alt+S or choose Split duration
press Alt+J or choose Join with next
press Alt+K or choose Split section here
press Alt+L or choose Join with next section
commit an exact beat value in the duration editor
confirm an explicit incomplete measure and reason
press Enter or activate Apply in the inline symbol editor
commit a section name field
commit a section annotation field
choose preserve or reset voice leading at a section boundary
click or press Enter on a chord card
shift-click or press Shift+Arrow
focus an insertion target and press Alt+P
activate Select range
activate Set start or commit the start beat field
activate Set end or commit the end beat field
activate Cancel in the range bar
activate the compact/teaching toggle
press Shift+F10 or activate More
press Escape in the inline editor
press Delete after the revision advanced
rows.note: A gesture whose captured revision is stale never reaches A0. This surface reaches that guarantee by capturing no revision outside quick entry, so there is no U1 refusal to name; U1-INT-051 states the quick-entry half.

reachability.reason: Only quick entry captures a revision; every other gesture reads the live snapshot at dispatch, so `delete-selection` has no captured revision that can go stale. The row's guarantee — a stale gesture never reaches A0 — therefore holds one step earlier than the row states, and the Delete that does run is the correct one against current state.

rows.gesture: activate Insert after another command replaced the document
rows.note: When the mismatch is only visible to A0, the command is dispatched and the application refusal code is surfaced verbatim.

rows.gesture: press F2 on a card whose voicing mode is manual
rows.note: Manual pitches are exact; U1 refuses the inline rename rather than relabelling stale pitches under a new symbol.

rows.gesture: press F2 on a card whose voicing mode is frozen
rows.note: Frozen voicings receive the same refusal as manual voicings.

rows.gesture: commit an unparsable symbol draft
rows.note: Apply commits only on a successful parse; the raw text is preserved.

rows.gesture: move focus out of an inline editor holding invalid text
rows.note: Blur neither commits nor coerces; the dirty draft prompts Apply, Discard, or Continue editing.

rows.gesture: commit a duration that exceeds the measure capacity
rows.note: Overfill is stated with its exact resulting fill and offers Move following events, Shorten, or Cancel; no silent rebalance occurs.

rows.gesture: commit a shorter duration without a completion reason
rows.note: An intentionally short measure requires an explicit reason; the first release synthesizes no rest.

rows.gesture: commit a shorter duration with an explicit incomplete reason
rows.note: The accepted underfill travels as one set-duration command carrying the exact incomplete completion update.

rows.gesture: join two nonadjacent events
rows.note: Only adjacent siblings inside one measure may join.

rows.gesture: join when the right event carries an annotation
rows.note: The join keeps the left annotation and refuses to discard the right one silently.

rows.gesture: split into two durations whose sum differs from the original
rows.note: The exact rational sum must equal the source duration.

rows.gesture: split a section at its first measure boundary
rows.note: A split must leave a nonempty leading section.

rows.gesture: join two nonadjacent sections
rows.note: Only adjacent sections may join.

rows.gesture: drop a dragged card on a destination inside its own subtree
rows.note: An ancestor/descendant destination refuses before dispatch.

rows.gesture: press Delete with no selection
rows.note: Delete requires a nonempty selection; the empty case is stated, not silently ignored.

rows.gesture: extend the selection to exactly 8,192 events
rows.note: Exactly the maximum selection size is accepted.

rows.gesture: extend the selection to 8,193 events
rows.note: One event beyond the maximum refuses before any intent is dispatched.

rows.gesture: activate Insert on a draft that T0 refuses
rows.note: When the surface cannot see the refusal in advance, the command is dispatched once and the nested refusal code is shown verbatim.

rows.gesture: attempt a voicing change from a chord card
rows.note: set-voicing, set-document-settings, transpose, apply-suggestion, apply-reharmonization, and replace-document are outside the U1 surface. No U1 control offers any of them, so the gesture has nothing to refuse: the proof is behavioural — driving the surface hard never moves a value those six commands own.

rows.gesture: activate Duplicate twice within one animation frame
rows.note: Each activation is one command; U1 never batches or nests commands in a single gesture.

rows.gesture: press Escape while editing a symbol
rows.note: Escape restores the exact prior source text and dispatches nothing.

rows.gesture: lose pointer capture during a drag
rows.note: A cancelled drag releases capture, removes its transient listeners, and dispatches nothing. Losing capture is a cancellation, not a refusal, so no code is named and none is shown to the reader.

rows.gesture: release the pointer after moving 7 CSS pixels
rows.note: Below the 8 CSS pixel threshold the gesture stays a tap; no drag starts and preventDefault is never called.

rows.gesture: type two characters into a section name within one second
rows.note: Section text coalesces exactly like the accepted A0 text policy: one retained history entry inside the window.

rows.gesture: type again after the coalescing window elapses
rows.note: Beyond the window the next keystroke opens a new history entry.

rows.gesture: choose Split at bar from the overfill notice
rows.note: The third overfill resolution. One atomic, singly undoable split-measure command; never two commands composed into one gesture.
